payload.rationale: Implements the NEC 220.82 Optional Calculation for Single-Family Dwelling Unit service sizing (general lighting, small appliance/laundry circuits, fastened appliances with 10 kVA threshold at 100% / 40% remainder, non-coincident HVAC selection, and NEC 230.79 minimum 100A service rating check), addressing a high-frequency gap on electrical engineering and plan review exams.
